error_budget.scope: Each of all six mode x M-factor cells separately, all seven worlds combined; all six required; negative variants fully reported, no chosen M

tolerance_rationale: Prospective engineering tolerances for limited synthetic validation, not estimated from held results; old sensitivity failures are already known. Cannot retrospectively justify old run or assert economic validity. No selection of a passing factor.

uncertainty.method: 10000 seed-block bootstrap, same five seeds paired across worlds/modes/factors
uncertainty.decision: Fixed empirical rates only; intervals descriptive, no population zero-error claim
